title.why: Decree 38/2025 lists the roadmap as 2026-2030, Komdigi's items of Feb and May 2026 give 2026-2029; the record's title follows the later Komdigi items, which is defensible. The run does not change the title; the extractor's open question stands.

date_published.why: The decree's signature date is that of the drafting programme, not of the drafts; it supports the year 2025 only, which is all the record states.

summary_claims.claim: Presidential Decree 38/2025 places both drafts in the 2026 programme
Inter-ministerial discussion with the State Secretariat ended 5 May 2026

note: Decree 38/2025 is an instrument of the President on an official law site, not an announcement, and shows the title, draft status and initiator; the Komdigi news items are labelled alt-official and the Hukumonline item secondary, as they should be. The roadmap period conflict (2026-2029 vs 2026-2030) stays an open question and is not changed by this run. Search found no enactment of either Perpres (latest reports July and August 2026 still say in process).
